basic_info.description: Welcome to 1635 10th Ave #4, a beautifully remodeled 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom unit that perfectly blends modern luxury with mid-century charm. Located in a boutique building in the vibrant Inner Sunset, this home is a tranquil retreat just moments from the city's best amenities. Step inside to an open-concept living and kitchen area featuring elegant wide-plank hardwood floors and abundant natural light from large north and west-facing windows. You'll enjoy serene outlooks to Golden Gate Park right from your living room! The gourmet kitchen is a chef's delight, equipped with sleek Caesarstone counters and top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, including a Liebherr refrigerator and a gas range with a powerful hood vent. Your peaceful sanctuary awaits in the spa-like bathroom, complete with a floor-to-ceiling tile and seamless glass shower enclosure. This home is completed with an in-unit washer and dryer, dedicated 1-car parking, and a private storage cage. The building itself offers a bright, inviting center atrium and is ideally located with easy access to the green expanse of Golden Gate Park, the bustling shops and eateries on Irving and 9th Avenues, and the nearby Stonestown Galleria Mall. Don't miss the opportunity to make this your new home!
